title: The iubenda | All-in-one Compliance for GDPR / CCPA Cookie Consent + more WordPress plugin before 3.13.7 does not…
description: The iubenda All-in-one Compliance for GDPR / CCPA Cookie Consent WordPress plugin before version 3.13.7 improperly escapes content re-emitted through its bundled HTML parser. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to inject arbitrary web scripts into pages, which execute in the context of any visitor viewing them, including logged-in administrators.
